name: wp-desktop-messages
description: Built-in 1-on-1 instant messaging for WP Desktop Mode.

scripts.build: npm run build:messages && npm run build:messages-shell
scripts.build:messages: WPDM_TARGET=messages vite build --mode development && WPDM_TARGET=messages vite build --mode production
scripts.build:messages-shell: WPDM_TARGET=messages-shell vite build --mode development && WPDM_TARGET=messages-shell vite build --mode production
